title: Exceptions and defensive parsing
summary: Handle expected bad records explicitly while allowing unexpected programming errors to surface.

blocks.text: Handle expected bad records explicitly while allowing unexpected programming errors to surface.

items: Catch the narrowest exception you can handle.
Keep parsing, validation and business rules separate.
Preserve the original value and error reason in a reject/quarantine path.
Avoid bare except because it also catches control-flow exceptions and hides defects.
